allow: PowerShell($ok = $false; foreach \($i in 1..15\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:5001/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; Write-Output "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) - $\($r.Content.Length\) bytes"; $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 } }; if \(-not $ok\) { Write-Output "no response after retries" })
